name: writing-investment-committee-memos
description: Drafts and reviews investment committee (IC) memos for private equity buyouts, growth equity, private credit and real estate investments: proposed recommendation and exact approval requested, investment thesis with falsifiable KPIs, management, sponsor, downside and exit-at-entry cases, dated IRR and MOIC tied to the model, value-creation bridge, exit multiple support, comparables selection, financing matched to commitment papers, risk matrix with probability, impact and mitigants, diligence status and findings, conflicts of interest (co-investment allocation, cross-fund investments, affiliated service providers, fee offsets, LPAC consent), MNPI handling, and SEC Marketing Rule checks when memo content may reach LPs or co-investors. Use for IC memo, investment committee paper, approval memo, screening memo, final IC deck text, turning LBO or valuation model outputs into an IC recommendation, or reviewing a draft memo before committee. Drafts for the deal team; the committee makes the investment decision.
